hook: A calibration-free imaging method recovers the M87* black hole ring, 42.2 microarcseconds wide.

readout.label: Angular diameter of the M87* ring

summary: An independent algorithm uses observables immune to instrument calibration errors and avoids built-in assumptions about shape. Applied to the Event Horizon Telescope M87* data, it reproduces a ring, implying a black hole mass of 6.5 billion suns. The mass depends on nominal scaling parameters, and the sparse interferometric data limit how fine the details can be.
title: Independent interferometric observable confirms black hole shadow in M87.
